夜色沉沉，压住了天渊城的哑巷。
泥墙歪斜，墙皮剥落，风一钻，便簌簌往下掉，落到脚边，碎成一层灰。
叶霄从巷口阴影里走出来，背上压着一捆破柴，肩骨被硌得生疼，身子却没晃一下。
柴是从工寮后头捡来的，松得厉害，稍一抖就得散。
散了，家里今晚就少一口火。
他脸瘦，手背冻裂，结着细细血痂，骨节粗硬。
转角处，忽然传来“啪”地一声脆响。
棍子抽在骨头上，声音又闷又狠。
一个瘦得脱了形的孩子被打得扑进黑泥水里，半张脸磕在石子上，当场裂开一道血口。
那孩子连哭都不敢，扑在地上去捡散落的铜板。
手冻得发紫，根本捏不稳。铜板刚捡起一点，就又从指缝里滚了出去。
他急得整个人都贴到了地上，最后干脆低下头，用牙把铜板咬住，咬稳了，才小心吐回掌心。
青枭帮的混子提着棍子，冷声开口：
“再掉一个，加一倍。”
“不够，就让你娘来按手印。”
“这就是拖欠的下场，给老子记清楚。”
话音刚落，棍子又砸了下去。
闷响砸进湿泥里。
孩子身子猛地一抖，却还是死死趴着，连动都不敢动，就怕铜板散了。

可随着又一棍落下，怀里那几枚铜板，还是被震出去一枚。
他想去捡。
却不敢。
只要一动，怀里剩下那几枚也得散。
那枚铜板一路滚，最后停在叶霄脚边。
铜板上沾着泥水，却还是亮得刺眼。
叶霄脚步没停，只慢了半拍。
鞋尖轻轻一压，把那点轻响压进泥里，脚背顺势一抹，铜板贴着地皮滑了回去，正好停在那孩子指尖够得到的地方。
孩子指尖一抖，赶紧把那枚铜板死死按进掌心。
棍子也停了一瞬。
孩子偷偷瞥了叶霄一眼，眼里没有求救，只有本能的畏缩。等看清是谁后，又赶紧把头埋了下去。
混子眼角扫过叶霄，棍尖在泥里一点，发出“嗒”的一声：
“多管闲事。”
叶霄没回头。
他知道，自己多看一眼，不只会给自己惹祸，也会让那孩子挨得更狠。

The night was dark, suppressing the mute alleys of Tianyuan City.
The mud wall was skewed and peeled off. When the wind blew through it, it rustled down and fell to the feet, shattering into a layer of dust.
Ye Xiao walked out of the shadows at the entrance of the alley, with a bundle of broken firewood on his back. His shoulder bones were painful, but his body did not move.
The firewood was picked up from the back of the workhouse. It was so loose that it would fall apart if it shook even a little.
If it breaks up, there will be less fire in the house tonight.
He has a thin face, the backs of his hands are cracked by frostbite, covered with fine blood scabs, and the joints are thick and hard.
Around the corner, there was a sudden "pop" sound.
The sound of the stick hitting the bone was muffled and harsh.
A child who was so thin that he was out of shape was beaten and threw himself into the black muddy water. Half of his face was hit on the stone, causing a bloody gash on the spot.
The child didn't even dare to cry. He threw himself on the ground to pick up the scattered coins.
My hands were so cold that I couldn't hold them firmly. As soon as the copper plate was picked up a little, it rolled out from the fingers again.
He was so anxious that he pressed his whole body to the ground. Finally, he simply lowered his head and bit the copper plate with his teeth. He bit it firmly before carefully spitting it back into his palm.
The gangster from the Qing Xiao Gang held a stick and said in a cold voice:
"One more drop, double it."
"If it's not enough, let your mother do the fingerprints."
"This is the consequences of defaulting, please remember it clearly."
As soon as he finished speaking, the stick hit him again.
It hit the wet mud with a muffled sound.
The child's body trembled violently, but he still lay flat on his stomach, not even daring to move, for fear that the coins would fall apart.
But as another stick fell, one of the few copper plates in his arms was knocked out.
He wanted to pick it up.
But dare not.
As long as he moves, the few remaining coins in his arms will be scattered.
The copper plate rolled all the way and finally stopped at Ye Xiao's feet.
The copper plate was stained with mud and water, but it was still bright and dazzling.
Ye Xiao didn't stop, only half a beat slower.
The toe of the shoe pressed lightly, pressing the soft sound into the mud. The instep of the foot slid smoothly, and the copper plate slid back against the ground, stopping just within reach of the child's fingertips.
The child's fingertips trembled and he quickly pressed the copper plate into his palm.
The stick also stopped for a moment.
The child glanced at Ye Xiao secretly. There was no cry for help in his eyes, only instinctive shrinking. After seeing who it was, he quickly buried his head.
The bastard glanced at Ye Xiao from the corner of his eyes, and when the tip of the stick was a little bit in the mud, he made a "click" sound:
"Mind your own business."
Ye Xiao didn't look back.
He knew that if he took one more look, he would not only get himself into trouble, but also make the child suffer even more.
